owner: RI-DLG04 §A — all 22 GMSTs, transcribed from OpenMW's defaultgmsts.cpp
provenance: community-data (OpenMW apps/opencs/model/world/defaultgmsts.cpp + mwmechanics/mechanicsmanagerimp.cpp); confidence medium-high on values, high on formulas
note_on_deviation: fDispCrimeMod ships at 0.0 in Morrowind. RI-DLG04 §B and §E rule 6 deviate DELIBERATELY to 0.02 so that a 1,000-gold bounty costs 20 disposition. Both channels are kept: fDispCrimeMod * bounty AND the separate crimeDispositionModifier written by witnessed theft/pickpocketing/assault. The vanilla value is preserved below under `vanilla` so a critic can diff.

bands.gates: Greeting band 1. Refuses all topics except the root nine. No services, no barter, no training.
Answers place/person/service topics tersely. Barter allowed at punitive prices. No faction business, no personal topics, no quest offers.
Full generic topic access. Faction quests offered if the player's rank qualifies. Training allowed.
Unlocks the NPC's personal/opinion topics and one tier of faction-internal gossip. Best prices.
Unlocks `little secret` and any topic marked confidential. Some quest branches exist ONLY here.

openmw_deviation_taken: On a marginal Intimidate win Morrowind applies x = 0, y = -iPerMinChange (widely held to be a bug; the Morrowind Code Patch fixes it). OpenMW applies x = iPerMinChange. We take OpenMW's fixed behaviour, per RI-DLG04's provenance note.
